summary: 75-year-old male hiker with a history of embolisms, last seen in Boulder the morning of Sept 3, went hiking solo in Rocky Mountain National Park instead of with his group; reported overdue that evening with his vehicle at the Chapin trailhead. A SARDOC dog team and rangers searched the Chapin Pass trail area; he emerged from the woods onto Old Fall River Road the next morning and flagged down a vehicle, having spent the night in a creek drainage.
location: Chapin trailhead, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Row dated at the report header date 9/4 (Friday-verified); subject hiked 9/3, took the wrong trail back from Mount Chiquita, and emerged the morning of 9/4.
